links.quote: By default, goose looks for both `AGENTS.md` and `.goosehints` at each level.

links.title: goose loads Agent Skills
links.quote: goose skills are compatible with Claude Desktop and other agents that support Agent Skills

links.title: goose extensions are MCP servers
links.quote: Extensions are based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

links.title: goose runs through Agent Router
links.quote: It shows how to create a single agent that handles both LLM (Large Language Model) calls and MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool calls through the same gateway.

links.title: A2A and MCP: two directions
links.quote: MCP is vertical. It deepens a single agent. … A2A is horizontal. It connects agents across that boundary.

links.title: agentgateway: MCP gateway
links.quote: MCP Gateway: Connect LLMs to tools and external data sources via MCP

links.title: agentgateway: A2A gateway
links.quote: A2A Gateway: Enable secure agent-to-agent communication using A2A

links.title: agentgateway: LLM gateway
links.quote: LLM Gateway: Route traffic to major LLM providers

links.title: Agent Router reaches MCP servers
links.quote: one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers

links.title: Agent Router reaches models
links.quote: one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers

links.title: Agent Router: A2A traffic (preview)
links.quote: Agent Router does not yet have a dedicated A2A route type. This page shows how to route A2A agents through the gateway today, using only Envoy Gateway resources plus the envoy.filters.http.a2a filter

links.title: OpenEnv serves tools over MCP
links.quote: MCP environments expose their tools to agents over `/mcp` in production mode

links.title: OpenSandbox ships an MCP server
links.quote: The OpenSandbox MCP server exposes sandbox creation, command execution, and text file operations to MCP-capable clients

links.title: OpenSandbox ships skills as SKILL.md
links.quote: The CLI ships with built-in OpenSandbox skills for coding agents and agent-oriented tools. … `./.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`

links.title: An app speaks Open Responses
links.quote: It defines a shared request/response model, streaming…

links.title: Open Responses: one interface, many providers
links.quote: multi-provider, interoperable LLM interfaces inspired by the OpenAI Responses API

links.title: Open Responses names MCP as an example
links.quote: MCP is another example, where external servers host the implementations

links.title: Open seam: two gateways
links.quote: Both route LLM and MCP traffic, and both document A2A: agentgateway as a gateway feature, Agent Router through a preview guide. Agent Router’s proposal 012 cites agentgateway as prior art for MCP tool-name prefixing. No AAIF document says where one gateway ends and the other begins.

links.title: Open seam: AGENTS.md and Agent Skills
links.quote: Both put instructions in front of an agent, and goose reads both. No primary document relates the two formats.
